instruction: The look-and-say sequence starts with 1. Each next term reads the previous term aloud: 1, 11, 21, 1211, 111221, ... What is the number of digits in the 20th term, counting the starting 1 as term 1? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to answer.txt.
